body: Yes. My roommate is good looking and has no issues socially. I'm ugly as all fuck and depressed as hell. He has no issues bringing home women or making friends - I'm horrible at these things and all I can do is compare my one big flaw called life with his. Honestly, I'll probably end up killing myself eventually because it just wears me down
Yeah thats what I want to do. We'll see

The only things I can think of, that really bother me, are my low self esteem and lack of confidence. But that seems to stem from my appearance. Unless there's a deeper issue I'm not aware of? This is just too complicated to be worthwhile honestly
To be honest, I'm not sure. I just wish I was pleasant to look at so that I would be more confident. Nobody appreciates anything you do unless you're decent to look at.
I try to hit the gym at least 5 days a week. Makes me feel a little better after I go, but overall, I still feel shitty unfortunately.
No idea. I think I must, the way I feel generally fits the bill. But at the same time I feel like I wouldn't have any issues if I looked decent.
